paragraphs.text: Hezekiah mourneth, and sendeth to Isaiah to pray for them, Isa 37:1-5. He comforteth them, Isa 37:6,7. Sennacherib, called away against the king of the Ethiopians, sendeth a blasphemous letter to Hezekiah, Isa 37:8-13. His prayer, Isa 37:14-20. Isaiah’s prophecy, Isa 37:21-35. An angel slayeth the Assyrians, Isa 37:36. Sennacherib is slain at Nineveh by his own sons, Isa 37:37,38.
For the understanding of this, and the foregoing chapter, the reader is desired to consult my notes upon 2Ki 18:1-20:21.
